许默抹了一把，腥味冲得他直皱眉。

还没等他喘口气。

第二批石像鬼如潮水般涌来，彻底遮蔽了头顶的阳光。

而在那群怪物中央，一头体长接近三米的庞然大物轰然落地，震得地面一阵发颤。浑身覆盖着泛着金属光泽的蓝色岩石铠甲，那双眸子暴虐的锁定了许默。

石像鬼首领。

“跑！别回头！”许默嘶吼着，拽着方芸的手腕往石林深处狂奔。

身后传来岩石碎裂的巨响，首领宽大的骨翼猛地一扇，小山般的身躯瞬间跨越了十几米的距离，利爪在地面上犁出两道深沟。

普通的石像鬼追了一阵就放慢了速度，但那只首领却有使不完的劲，紧咬不放。

许默穿过一片密集石柱林，首领的体型太大，被两根石柱卡了一下，发出愤怒的咆哮。

这是一瞬间的机会，许默拉着方芸钻进一条只有一人宽的岩缝，弯着腰跑了将近百米，才从另一头钻出来。

身后的振翅声终于远了。

两人瘫在地上，大口喘息。

方芸的腿在发抖，许默也好不到哪去，虎口上还有之前被拍裂的旧伤，此刻渗出了血丝。

方芸急喘气道。

“这东西根本不是我们现在能碰的。”

许默没说话，只是抬头看了一眼天色。

太阳已经开始偏西，再过几个小时天就黑了。

他站起来，把方芸拉起来：“回营地，先回去。”

返程的路出奇的安静，两人都没说话，脚步匆忙，只想在天黑前赶回营地。

就在两人即将踏出石林外围的瞬间，许默脚下的泥土毫无预兆地发出一声沉闷的悲鸣。

那声音像是什么东西在地下断裂了，紧接着，脚下的地面开始往下沉。

崩塌只在眨眼之间发生。

“让开！”许默猛地一把推在方芸的肩膀上。

失重感瞬间袭来。

许默连固定身形的机会都没有，直直坠入深不见底的地底裂缝。

没有想象中骨断筋折。

身下的触感极其诡异。

黏稠、温热，甚至带着令人作呕的肉质蠕动感。

许默屏住呼吸，迅速翻身跃起，入眼是一片黑暗，只有头顶缝隙透下来的一丝微光。

Xu Mo wiped it on, and the fishy smell made him frown.

Before he could take a breath.

The second batch of gargoyles came like a tide, completely blocking the sunlight above them.

In the center of the group of monsters, a huge monster nearly three meters in length crashed to the ground, causing the ground to tremble.The whole body was covered with blue rock armor with a metallic luster, and those eyes locked on Xu Mo violently.

The leader of the gargoyles.

"Run! Don't look back!" Xu Mo roared, grabbing Fang Yun's wrist and running wildly deeper into the stone forest.

There was a loud sound of shattering rocks behind him, and the leader's broad bone wings suddenly flapped. His hill-like body instantly spanned a distance of more than ten meters, and his sharp claws plowed two deep grooves on the ground.

Ordinary gargoyles would slow down after chasing for a while, but the leader had endless energy and wouldn't let go.

Xu Mo walked through a dense forest of stone pillars. The leader was so big that he got stuck on two stone pillars and let out an angry roar.

This was a momentary opportunity. Xu Mo pulled Fang Yun into a rock crevice only one person wide, bent over and ran for nearly a hundred meters before emerging from the other end.

The sound of flapping wings behind me finally faded away.

The two of them collapsed on the ground, gasping for air.

Fang Yun's legs were trembling, and Xu Mo was not much better. There were old wounds on the tiger's mouth that had been cracked before, and blood was oozing out at the moment.

Fang Yun gasped.

"This thing is simply not something we can touch now."

Xu Mo didn't say anything, just raised his head and glanced at the sky.

The sun was already starting to set in the west, and it would be dark in a few hours.

He stood up and pulled Fang Yun up: "Go back to the camp, go back first."

The journey back was surprisingly quiet. Neither of them spoke. They were walking in a hurry, just wanting to get back to the camp before dark.

Just when the two of them were about to step out of the stone forest, the soil under Xu Mo's feet let out a dull scream without warning.

The sound sounded like something was breaking underground, and then, the ground beneath my feet began to sink.

The collapse occurs in the blink of an eye.

"Get out of the way!" Xu Mo pushed Fang Yun on the shoulder.

The feeling of weightlessness came over me instantly.

Xu Mo didn't even have a chance to stabilize his body, and fell straight into the bottomless crack in the ground.

No broken bones or tendons as imagined.

The feeling underneath him was extremely strange.

Thick, warm, and even disgustingly fleshy.

Xu Mo held his breath and quickly turned over and jumped up. What he saw was darkness, with only a glimmer of light coming from the gap above his head.
